articles.title: Sea drone explodes in the Romanian port of Constanta, no casualties
articles.summary: A sea drone exploded without casualties in Romania's Black Sea port of Constanta on Friday, a week after an aerial drone injured two in a separate incident. These events highlight the growing risks of spillover from the Ukraine conflict impacting neighboring NATO nations. For aspirants, this underscores the evolving threats to maritime security and critical infrastructure in strategically vital regions.

articles.title: Rafale fires MICA NG missile: All about the next-generation weapon built to target stealth aircraft, drones and cruise missiles
articles.summary: France successfully conducted the second development firing of its MICA NG (Missile d'Interception, de Combat et d'Auto-défense Nouvelle Génération) air-to-air missile. This crucial test demonstrates the advanced capabilities of the new generation missile, enhancing France's aerial combat readiness and self-defense systems. Such advancements are vital for modernizing air forces globally, impacting future defence strategies and technological superiority.

articles.title: Rafale fires MICA NG missile designed to hunt stealth jets in first supersonic test
articles.summary: France successfully conducted the second development firing of its next-generation MICA NG air-to-air missile from a Rafale fighter jet near Paris. This crucial test validates significant advancements in French defence technology, enhancing the Rafale's combat capabilities. Such developments underscore the importance of modern air warfare systems and aerospace self-reliance, key aspects for understanding global defence dynamics.

articles.title: Former CIA officer accused of stashing gold bars ordered to remain jailed pending trial
articles.summary: A former CIA officer, found with $40 million in gold bars at his Virginia home, appeared in court on Friday. A judge ordered him to remain in custody until his trial. The case involves allegations of illicit activities by a former intelligence official, raising questions about his wealth accumulation post-service and potential national security implications.

articles.title: India is witnessing strong growth for Made-in-India vehicles: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: India's automotive sector exhibited significant growth in May, with passenger vehicle sales soaring by a remarkable 23% year-on-year. This robust performance highlights the sector's resilience and positive momentum, contributing substantially to the national economy. Such expansion reflects improving consumer confidence and a strong domestic market, vital indicators for India's overall economic health and development.
